verdict.rationale: GitLab documents its own self-managed deployment options: the Linux package, official Docker images, Helm chart/Operator for cloud-native installs, and self-compilation. Running a self-managed instance lets a customer place their data wherever they host it, and community users confirm running private instances. However, the evidence never documents region or residency selection for the hosted GitLab.com offering, and no residency guarantees are stated. missing for 10: documented region/data-residency selection for hosted GitLab (SaaS/dedicated), explicit residency commitments, coverage of where AI/Duo data is processed.
